title: Makes a yaml file with required packages etc — chk_make
code:
pak <- read.csv(   text = "package, recommended, minimum, message         dplyr, 1.0.9, NA, NA         ggplot2, 3.3.5, 3.3.1, NA",   strip.white = TRUE )  prog <- read.csv(text = 'program, recommended, minimum, message              rstudio, 2022.12.0.353, NA, NA              R, "4.2.2", "4.1.1", NA              git, NA, NA, NA',              strip.white = TRUE) opt <- read.csv(text = 'option, value, message              "save_workspace", "never", NA              "load_workspace", "FALSE", "For reproducibility"',              strip.white = TRUE)  f  <- tempfile(fileext = ".yaml") (chk_make(path = f, programs = prog, packages = pak, options = opt)) #> [1] "rstudio:
  recommended: 2022.12.0.353
  options:
    save_workspace:
      value: never
    load_workspace:
      value: 'FALSE'
      message: For reproducibility
R:
  recommended: 4.2.2
  minimum: 4.1.1
git: NA
packages:
  dplyr:
    recommended: 1.0.9
  ggplot2:
    recommended: 3.3.5
    minimum: 3.3.1
" #chk_requirements(f) unlink(f)
